claims: The 2026 NFL Draft takes place April 23–25 in Pittsburgh, PA.
The 2026 NFL Draft is held in and around Acrisure Stadium.
The 2026 NFL Draft is free to the public.
The 2026 NFL Draft features a Draft Experience at Point State Park.
The location of the 2026 NFL Draft is Pittsburgh, PA (North Shore and Point State Park).
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft is on April 23.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on April 24.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on April 25.
Fernando Mendoza is a QB for Indiana.
Drew Allar is a QB for Penn State.
Caleb Downs is an OT for Ohio State.
QB Fernando Mendoza (Indiana), QB Drew Allar (Penn State), and OT Caleb Downs (Ohio State) are high-profile names in the 2026 class.
Coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft is available on ESPN.
Coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft is available on ABC.
Coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft is available on the ESPN App.
The 2026 NFL Draft order is determined by the reverse order of the 2025 regular-season record.
The 32nd pick in the 2026 NFL Draft goes to the Super Bowl champion.
Mel Kiper Jr.'s 2026 mock draft anticipates significant early trades.
Indiana QB Fernando Mendoza is projected as a top prospect.
